```plato

// A lossless pixel reorientation (the eight EXIF orientations).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exif)
type ImageOrientation
    = Identity
    | FlipHorizontal
    | Rotate180
    | FlipVertical
    | Transpose
    | Rotate90
    | Transverse
    | Rotate270;
```
